description: This PHP class 'ModuleScreen' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing modules and screens within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It encapsulates properties for module and screen names, including overridden versions, with getter and setter methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: ModuleScreen
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for encapsulating information about a module and screen, including their overridden counterparts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing 'module' and 'screen', and setting their overridden counterparts.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name and updates overridden module if necessary.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen name and updates overridden screen if necessary.
